Mateo / Marissa —

Read the draft. A few internal notes before we send the v2 to Nimbus:
1) Commission math: instead of flat %-of-ARR, propose a two-step payout: 60% on first-year ARR booking (to align with cash flow) and remaining 40% after month-12 renewal or if partner-sourced expansion occurs within 12 months. This reduces clawback risk.
2) Registration verification: require CRM opportunity ID + first-touch email thread + a short intake form that includes expected ARR and product scope. We should automate verification by mapping registration form fields to a webhook into our partner portal.
3) Shorten the registration window to 30 days conditional on signed MAP + CRM proof; keep 45 days for unverified leads. This is a common compromise and reduces disputes.
4) MAP detail: include an explicit pilot success metric (e.g., latency below X for 5k prompt tokens / day) so we can tie technical support credits to milestones.

Also cc'ing Ben to start a light legal review on any standard warranty & data handling clauses. Once we align internally I'll send the v2 to Nimbus.
